test_prerequisites.offline_install: Named helper release/prime-consumer-cache.mjs does one online file: install of the admitted runtime tarball into an explicit AITHEMA_NPM_CACHE. npm ci alone caches lockfile tarballs and does not prime packuments. GitHub Release tarball dependencies (Flow Shell 0.1.2) are stored content-addressed; npm --offline cannot replay that HTTP URL, so the packaging test replays the primed integrity blob as a file: override after verifying the independently known SHA256. The packaging test then asserts npm install --offline of a fresh consumer against that cache.

ci.canonical_toolchain_enforcement: AITHEMA_CANONICAL_RELEASE=1 on the release workflow; local BSD tar builds remain valid and are not byte-identical to GNU tar

reproducibility.boundary: Published bytes are reproducible under the canonical GNU tar toolchain used by CI. BSD tar may emit different archive bytes for the same tree; local macOS builds are valid for development but are not the publication basis.
reproducibility.timestamp_policy_note: Git-mode uses the committer epoch of the exported commit. Tree-mode reuses provenance.export_mtime_epoch recorded for that current_source_commit. Runtime source.commit is that current commit under frozen aithema-release-manifest/0.1; private_source_commit remains independent lineage in source provenance.
